title: Upstream balance
label: Balance
unlimited: The upstream reports an unlimited quota for this key.
unsupported: This upstream does not expose a balance endpoint.
refreshHint: Click to query the upstream again.
toolbarHint: Balances come from each provider's own key or its configured New API system access token, and refresh automatically every 10 minutes.

errors.access_token_rejected: The upstream rejected the system access token. Check the token and the user ID.
errors.forbidden: This key is not allowed to read the balance.
errors.rate_limited: The upstream rate-limited the balance query.
errors.invalid_response: The upstream returned an unreadable response.
errors.network: The balance query could not reach the upstream.
errors.invalid_url: The provider address is not a valid URL.
